data.title: One Zaabeel
data.about:
One Za’abeel Residences, developed by Ithra Dubai, is an architectural landmark nestled in the heart of Zabeel. Completed in 2023, this 59-storey residential tower forms part of the iconic One Za’abeel complex—an integrated development that also features a Grade A office tower and a luxury hotel. With its strategic location and striking design, it offers a distinguished address in one of Dubai’s most prestigious districts.

Comprising 264 exquisitely designed units, One Za’abeel Residences offers a curated selection of 1 to 4-bedroom simplexes and duplexes, alongside a singular 5-bedroom penthouse. Residents benefit from an impressive suite of amenities, including a beach-style swimming pool, state-of-the-art fitness centre, spa facilities, lush outdoor gardens, children’s play areas, games rooms, and dedicated valet services—setting a new benchmark for luxurious urban living in Dubai.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Landmark Location - Set within the prestigious One Za’abeel complex, connecting business, leisure, and luxury in the heart of Dubai.
  • Architectural Prestige - A 59-storey tower designed to redefine skyline living with unmatched style and sophistication.
  • Exclusive Residences - Choose from 1 to 5-bedroom simplexes, duplexes, and a penthouse—all crafted for elevated comfort and elegance.
  • World-Class Amenities - Indulge in resort-style features including a beach-style pool, spa, gardens, games rooms, and dedicated valet services.

location_tile.title: At the crossroads of prestige and connectivity
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the vibrant district of Zabeel, One Za’abeel Residences enjoys a prime location near Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Road (E11), one of Dubai’s major arterial routes. This strategic position offers residents seamless access to key destinations across the city, including Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport—making it an ideal address for both refined living and effortless connectivity.

  • 5 Minutes – Sheikh Zayed Road (E11)
  • 5 Minutes – Za’abeel Palace
  • 13 Minutes – Dubai Mall
  • 15 Minutes – Burj Khalifa
  • 30 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
